value.rationale: The five-site cycle is the minimum unaliased periodic realization of this classical five-point fourth-order stencil, giving a natural sharp test instance for preservation of nodal nonnegativity. Its previously unspecified exact entrywise restoration horizon and complete negative-entry census separate spectral dissipation and mass conservation from the discrete maximum principle and provide an exact regression benchmark for higher-order heat solvers. This is a motivated finite-size invariant, not a numerical table update or a claim about all grid sizes; no downstream theorem is asserted.
